result: Redacted once-only process exit records and existing-pool health pressure are implemented and tested.

inputs.good: Child process normal exit and TypeError from the repository test file.
inputs.difficult: Synthetic credential-shaped error message and invalid code; neither appears in the record.
inputs.dataFiles: Not applicable to process diagnostics; no survey files or runtime configuration opened.

decisions: Use uncaughtExceptionMonitor to retain Node's default fatal outcome; restore default rejection throwing when no app handler exists.
SIGTERM records code null before shutdown; app handlers retain control, otherwise re-send the signal with our listener removed.
Keep record.preload as isolated-env.cjs for compatibility; add exit-record.cjs as a second require.
Pool and health tests live in the API workspace so its dependencies resolve; all dependency calls are stand-ins.
execution: TMP, TEMP and TMPDIR set to E:/ulpin-tmp. Server tests and OpenAPI check used isolated-env.cjs with ULPIN_PROFILE=demo; tests used REPO_DATA=false.
limits: No runtime launched; actual load survival remains for rehearsal. Demo and existing runtime folders were not touched.
SIGTERM delivery is simulated in the child test on Windows. Forced Windows termination and native aborts bypass JavaScript hooks.
next: Lead regenerates OpenAPI, client types and source pins at integration; rehearse exit records and pool samples under load.
